answers:
## North America — Q1 2024 revenue

**$3,593 million** (reported), per the Q1 2024 zone-by-zone results [DOC-001] and AB InBev's First Quarter 2024 Results release (BusinessWire, 7 May 2024).

Supporting metrics for the same zone and period [DOC-001]:

| Metric | Q1 2024 |
| --- | --- |
| Revenue | $3,593M |
| Organic growth | −8.8% |
| Volume | 21,353K hL |
| Normalized EBITDA | $1,126M |
| Normalized EBITDA margin | 31.3% |

## Commentary behind it

The retrieved evidence gives the **quantitative** picture but only limited qualitative narrative:

- Revenue in North America **declined 8.8% on an organic basis**, the weakest organic growth of the zones reported in the same document (Middle Americas +8.0%, South America +5.1%) [DOC-001].
- **Organic growth** here means growth excluding foreign-currency translation and scope changes (acquisitions/disposals), so the −8.8% isolates underlying business performance rather than FX or portfolio effects [DOC-013].
- **Normalized EBITDA was $1,126M at a 31.3% margin** — notably lower margin than Middle Americas (46.6%) in the same quarter [DOC-001], indicating the revenue decline carried through to profitability.

**Transparency note:** the retrieved documents do not include the specific management explanation for the North America decline (e.g., US beer-industry trends, brand-mix or channel commentary). Only the headline figures above are supported by the evidence provided — I can't attribute a driver that isn't in the source material.

## Adjacent context (for reference)

- **Q1 2025**: North America revenue $3,364M, organic growth **−4.7%**, volume 19,842K hL, normalized EBITDA $1,087M (32.3% margin) [DOC-005] — i.e., still declining a year later, but at a slower organic rate.
- **Q4 2024**: North America revenue $3,331M, organic growth **+1.7%**, volume 19,516K hL, normalized EBITDA $969M (29.1% margin) [DOC-004].

---

1. How does North America's Q1 2024 organic decline compare with Middle Americas and South America on a volume and EBITDA-margin basis?
2. What did North America's revenue trajectory look like across Q1 2024 → Q4 2024 → Q1 2025?
